ναασσων.def: Nahshon, son of Amminadab and father of Salmon, and one of the ancestors of Jesus.

ναγγαι.def: Naggai, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

ναζαρετ.def: Nazareth, a city of Galilee, where Jesus lived before His ministry.

ναζωραιοσ.def: a Nazarene, an inhabitant of Nazareth.

ναθαν.def: Nathan, son of David, and an ancestor of Jesus.

ναθαναηλ.def: Nathanael, of Cana in Galilee, an early disciple, probably to be identified with Bartholomew.

ναιν.def: Nain, a city south-west of the Sea of Galilee.

ναοσ.def: a temple, a shrine, that part of the temple where God himself resides.

ναρδοσ.def: spikenard, a perfume made originally from a plant growing on the Himalayas.

ναυαγεω.def: (a) I am shipwrecked; so (b) fig: I come to ruin.

ναυκληροσ.def: a captain (master) of a ship, ship-owner.

ναχωρ.def: Nahor, one of the ancestors of Jesus.

νεανιασ.def: a young man, youth; a man in his prime (used even of a man of 40).

νεανισκοσ.def: a young man, youth, an attendant.

νεκροσ.def: (a) adj: dead, lifeless, subject to death, mortal, (b) noun: a dead body, a corpse.

νεκροω.gloss: I put to death, render weak
νεκροω.def: lit. and met: I put to death, make as dead; I render weak, impotent.

νεκρωσισ.def: (a) putting to death, (b) dead or lifeless condition.

νεοσσοσ.def: a young bird, nestling; a young one.

νεοφυτοσ.def: (lit: newly-planted), newly converted to Christianity, recent convert.

νευω.def: I nod, make a sign, beckon.

νεφθαλειμ.def: Naphtali, son of Jacob, founder of a tribe which occupied territory.

νεφοσ.def: a cloud; met: a dense crowd, a multitude, great company.

νεφροσ.gloss: a kidney as a general emotional center
νεφροσ.def: a kidney (as a general emotional center), the reins.

νη.def: of affirmative swearing: by, with acc. of person or thing sworn by.

νηπιοσ.def: unlearned, unenlightened; noun: an infant, child.

νηφαλεοσ.def: sober, not intoxicated (with wine), temperate, vigilant.

νηφω.def: (lit: I am sober), I am calm (vigilant), circumspect.

νικαω.def: I conquer, am victorious, overcome, prevail, subdue.

νικοδημοσ.def: Nicodemus, a member of the Sanhedrin.

νικολαιτησ.def: a Nicolaitan, possibly a follower of Nicolaus (a heretic at Ephesus).

νινευι.def: Nineveh, a city on the Tigris in Assyria.

νινευιτησ.def: a Ninevite, an inhabitant of Nineveh, a city on the Tigris in Assyria.

νιπτηρ.def: a basin for washing hands or feet.

νιπτω.def: I wash; mid. I wash my own (hands, etc.).

νοεω.def: I understand, think, consider, conceive, apprehend; aor. possibly: realize.

νοημα.def: a thought, purpose, design; the mind; the heart, soul, feelings.

νομιζω.def: I practice, hold by custom; I deem, think, consider, suppose.

νομικοσ.gloss: about law, one learned in the Law
νομικοσ.def: (a) adj: connected with law, about law, (b) noun: a lawyer, one learned in the Law, one learned in the Old Testament.

νομοδιδασκαλοσ.gloss: a teacher and interpreter of the Mosaic Law
νομοδιδασκαλοσ.def: a teacher and interpreter of the Mosaic Law.

νομοθετεω.def: (a) I ordain, lay down, give the sanction of law to, enact, (b) I base legally, regulate, direct.

νομοσ.def: usage, custom, law; in NT: of law in general, plur: of divine laws; of a force or influence impelling to action; of the Mosaic law; meton: of the books which contain the law, the Pentateuch, the Old Testament scriptures in general.

νοσεω.def: I am diseased, hence of mental or spiritual disease.

νοσσιον.gloss: a nestling, the young of birds
νοσσιον.def: a nestling, the young of birds.

νοσφιζω.def: I rob; mid: I set apart for myself, appropriate for my own benefit, purloin.

νουμηνια.gloss: the new moon as a festival
νουμηνια.def: the new moon, first of the month.

νουσ.def: the mind, the reason, the reasoning faculty, intellect.

νυμφη.def: (a) a bride, young wife, young woman, (b) a daughter-in-law.

νυν.def: adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

νυνι.def: adv. (a) of time: just now, even now; just at hand, immediately, (b) of logical connection: now then, (c) in commands and appeals: at this instant.

νυσταζω.gloss: I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber
νυσταζω.def: I nod in sleep, am drowsy, slumber.

νυχθημερον.def: a night and day, twenty-four hours.

νωθροσ.def: blunt, dull, hence spiritually; sluggish, remiss, slack.

νωτοσ.gloss: the back of men or animals
